location.context: build_sidebar_tree() / _render_children_html() -- per-folder <details> only, no all-at-once control

What's genuinely missing is only a convenience on top of both: no single 'collapse all / expand all' control for a project with many top-level folders.

issues.description: Raised in response to 'is folder collapsing supported' -- yes, already shipped; this is the one adjacent, genuinely-missing convenience worth naming so it doesn't get silently dropped from consideration.
